indicators.name: Hyperscaler capex / operating cash flow (mean of latest quarter, MSFT GOOGL AMZN META ORCL)
indicators.rationale: Capex consuming most/all operating cash flow implies reliance on external funding.

indicators.name: Capex YoY minus revenue YoY (mean, same five companies)
indicators.rationale: Investment growing far faster than revenue for a sustained period is a classic over-build signal.

indicators.name: Hyperscaler free-cash-flow margin, FCF / revenue (mean of latest quarter)
indicators.rationale: Capex absorbing cash flow shows up as a thin or negative FCF margin. (FCF YoY was rejected as an indicator: it is ill-defined when the prior-year FCF is near zero or negative.)

indicators.name: Hyperscaler capex / revenue (mean)
indicators.rationale: Capital intensity far above historical software-company norms.

indicators.name: AI-specific capex (company-disclosed)
indicators.detail: No company discloses AI-only capex in machine-readable form (metric ai_capex_disclosed is UNAVAILABLE).

indicators.name: Trailing P/E, Taiwan AI supply chain (mean of 2330, 2382, 2317; TWSE)
indicators.rationale: Elevated multiples on the hardware supply chain price in sustained AI demand.

indicators.name: Forward P/E, US AI leaders
indicators.detail: Forward consensus estimates need a licensed data source (metric forward_pe is UNAVAILABLE).

indicators.name: Drawdown from 52-week high (mean of available AI equities)
indicators.rationale: Broad, deep drawdowns indicate the market is de-rating AI expectations (stress, not valuation level).

indicators.name: Drawdown from 52-week high (mean of NASDAQ-100 and PHLX Semiconductor, FRED)
indicators.rationale: Keyless market-stress gauge for the AI trade (index level, so not a valuation measure).

indicators.name: Disclosed AI revenue vs AI capex
indicators.detail: Hyperscaler AI revenue is disclosed only irregularly and as lower bounds (e.g. AMZN 'exceeded $25B AWS AI run rate', 8-K 2026-07-30); no company discloses AI capex, so 'AI revenue vs AI capex' cannot be computed.

indicators.name: Frontier-lab compute & infrastructure expense / revenue (Anthropic S-1, latest quarter, company-disclosed)
indicators.rationale: Inference/training compute consuming most of a frontier lab's revenue means AI demand is not yet self-funding. Single company, company-disclosed (pre-IPO S-1, unaudited quarterly), not reported financials; OpenAI has no comparable disclosure. Research hypothesis, not a validated threshold.

indicators.name: Median observed list-price change of frontier-vendor models (trailing 365 days)
indicators.detail: observed price history is 2 days (since 2026-10-26); need 90. Undocumented past prices are never back-filled.
indicators.rationale: Steep, broad price cuts suggest commoditization faster than volume growth can offset.

indicators.name: NVIDIA Data Center revenue YoY (latest quarter, SEC XBRL)
indicators.rationale: Extreme supplier growth indicates an investment boom phase whose durability is uncertain.

indicators.name: Azure H100 (ND96isr_H100_v5) Spot discount vs pay-as-you-go list, eastus
indicators.rationale: A deep spot discount suggests idle capacity. Caveat - list prices are sticky (unchanged since 2023-12).

indicators.name: TSMC (2330) monthly revenue YoY (TWSE t187ap05_L, exchange-published)
indicators.rationale: Foundry revenue growth far above its long-run ~15% trend signals boom-phase demand whose durability is uncertain (same logic as NVDA Data Center YoY). Research hypothesis, not a validated threshold.

indicators.name: US 10Y Treasury yield (FRED DGS10)
indicators.rationale: Higher discount rates compress long-duration valuations and raise funding costs.

indicators.name: Moody's Baa - 10Y Treasury credit spread (FRED BAA10Y)
indicators.rationale: Very tight credit spreads signal complacent risk pricing typical of late-cycle booms (stretched = tight). Proxy: investment-grade Baa spread; ICE BofA high-yield OAS skipped (FRED licence: pre-approval required). Research hypothesis, not a validated threshold.

indicators.name: METR time-horizon doubling time (2023-on fit, days)
indicators.rationale: Slower capability growth undermines the thesis behind current capex.

indicators.name: Terminal-Bench top accuracy (latest dataset version only)
indicators.rationale: Low agent success on realistic tasks implies costly human review (see ROI simulator).

label: Research prototype. Thresholds are research hypotheses, not validated predictions.
